CISA ScubaGear Report - Exchange Online

This report assesses Microsoft Exchange Online against the security baselines from CISA's Secure Cloud Business Applications (ScubaGear) project, using CIPP's built-in CISA test library. Each item reports Passed, Failed, or Skipped based on the live tenant configuration at run time.

Scope note: CIPP's CISA test set currently implements the Exchange Online baseline (the MS.EXO controls). Other ScubaGear product baselines are not yet part of this test library, so this report covers Exchange Online only.

ScubaGear baselines are published by the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) and are in the public domain. Source: github.com/cisagov/ScubaGear. This template is original work by AppliedI and references CIPP's built-in test identifiers.
